rules: Navigation generated from the verified pinned release; not evidence about any Qualia entity.
Choose a predicate only when its meaning, subject, object, literal and qualifiers match actual evidence.
No generic source-report predicate exists. Never attach a proposition to an unrelated predicate to satisfy a report citation.
Authorizing predicates require the corresponding edge.assert shape; executor-owned relationships cannot be authored as structural edges.

boundEffectDigest.description: sha256:<hex> of the exact normalized native effect the use decision bound (R-SV10); the apply verifies it before writing.

bundleDigest.description: verification.v1 sealed audit bundle digest, when the run produced one.

effectKey.description: Effect key of the applied effect (the KsIntentMarker scope key, R-SV10).

intentDigests.description: biotech-knowledge-intent.v1 digests and plan digests of the intents the run applied (ADR 0003), in apply order.

methodVersion.description: Executor or method version that makes outputs interpretable.

operationIds.description: Operation intent ids (Mission Control) or the Knowledge Services operation id(s) this run executed.

operationKind.description: The run's main step: knowledge.ingestion_apply, verification_claims, entity-link projection, ...

originatingOrigin.description: Canonical JSON digest (or compact string) of the admitted original invocation (origin) the effect descends from (R-SV10).

policyOutcome.description: verification.v1 policy outcome of the run, and the PolicyVersion id applied.

receiptIds.description: biotech-knowledge-receipt.v1 ids (the references Mission Control stores), in apply order.

revocationEpoch.description: Revocation epoch checked at admission under the native transaction (R-SV10).

runId.description: Mission Control run.runId (or verification run UUID); replaces externalRunId / mongoResearchRunId.

runManifestDigest.description: sha256:<hex> of the canonical unsigned sealed run manifest this Activity references (R-SV10).

runSealKind.description: Which seal runManifestDigest names (verification, decision or admission snapshot, R-SV10).

useDecisionDigest.description: sha256:<hex> digest of that use decision record (R-SV11); official reads compare it with the authority's record before serving.

useDecisionRef.description: Immutable reference to the Knowledge Services use decision the applied effect was admitted under (R-SV10).

verificationRunRef.description: Knowledge Services verification run id (the common operational run; PostgreSQL owns the run and its manifests, R-SV10).

assertionVersionRef.description: Immutable reference to the Knowledge Services AssertionVersion this record materializes (R-SV10); the version store is PostgreSQL, not the graph.

claimType.description: Required when assertionKind is CLAIM (verification.v1 rule).

contentHash.description: sha256:<hex> over the canonical immutable content.

derivationRule.description: Named rule for a CALCULATED assertion or an INFERRED bound.

extractionConfidence.description: Extraction dimension of confidence; interpretable only with the generating Activity's methodVersion.

logicalAssertionId.description: Logical assertion id shared by every version of the same proposition (Knowledge Services AssertionVersion.logicalId, R-SV10).

predicate.description: Registered predicate (release vocabularies/predicates.yaml, status registered; an alias-of name is re-keyed to its target before ingest, a retired or unknown name is rejected, R-52, MD-X-02); equals the edge type for an asserted edge.

proposition.description: Natural-language proposition (verification.v1 proposition) when the record is not a typed literal.

qualifiers.description: verification.v1 qualifiers (population, dose, condition) that must survive any retelling; registered prefixes such as `segment:<KIND>` (D9 segment of a media work: SPONSOR_READ, EDITORIAL, ...), `population:<code>`, `rendition:<source uid>`, `target:<key>` (a D5 Target key, R-83), `comparatorArm:<arm uid>` and `comparator:<QuantityComparator>` (MD-D12-02), `asserterBasis:PUBLISHER_DEFAULT|INFERRED` (R-16), `sourceRecordRemovedAt:<date>` (the source's own record time, R-24). The name, separator and value grammar of every registered qualifier is the release qualifier registry vocabularies/qualifiers.yaml (bks-qualifier-grammar.v1); an unregistered qualifier name is rejected by the executor.

qualifiersDigest.description: sha256:<hex> over the canonical JSON of the profile-specific qualifiers of the AssertionVersion (R-SV10). The graph does not model profile qualifier schemas; a qualifier change is a new digest and invalidates reuse.

recordedAt.description: Service-assigned commit time (recorded-time start); never before the cited snapshot's retrievedAt.

riskClass.description: verification.v1 riskClass (low|medium|high|critical) when the producer declared one.

supersedesUid.description: uid of the Assertion this one supersedes (newer → older); same asserter only (R-23).

supportSetDigest.description: sha256:<hex> of the selected support set (conjunctive required premises and their evidence fragments) the use decision bound (R-SV10).

unitCode.description: UCUM unit of valueNumber, or an ISO 4217 currency written `iso4217:<CODE>` for a price.

validObservedAt.description: Date at which the source states the fact held when it gives no bounds (validFromBasis OBSERVATION_ONLY keeps validFrom null).

verificationAssertionId.description: verification.v1 assertionId when the verifier saw this record.

assessmentSubkind.description: Domain detail of the kind, registered by the owning domain (e.g. D5.interaction-risk).

conclusionCode.description: Categorical outcome from the vocabulary registered for assessmentSubkind by the owning domain.

evidenceCutoffAt.description: Latest evidence the assessment considered (as-of cutoff).

expiresAt.description: Expiry of the use decision, when it has one (R-SV10).

facets.description: Registered `<facet>=<value>` codes for further categorical facets (filter with includes).

grade.description: Grade under gradeScheme, as the scheme spells it.

gradeScheme.description: Named grading scheme (GRADE, OCEBM-2011, USPSTF-2012, CTCAE_V5, LIVERTOX-LIKELIHOOD, BELLLABS-<name>@<version>).

inputSetDigest.description: sha256:<hex> over the sorted input uids and their contentHashes.

policyRef.description: Versioned policy reference the use decision was taken under (R-SV10).

reviewerAdjudicationRef.description: Reference to the qualified human reviewer adjudication that signed the exact bindings, when one did (R-SV10).

revocationEpoch.description: Revocation epoch (authoritative per-scope high-water mark) the decision was checked against (R-SV10). A projection never authorizes use after an observed later epoch; official reads revalidate eligibility.

rubricRef.description: Versioned rubric reference (assessment kind version) the judgment applied (R-SV10).

score.description: The method's own score (e.g. resolution score); never a truth value.

useDecisionDigest.description: sha256:<hex> digest of that use decision record (R-SV11); official reads compare it with the authority's record before serving.

useDecisionRef.description: Immutable reference to the Knowledge Services use decision (PostgreSQL authority) this assessment records (R-SV10).

useDisposition.description: Disposition of that use decision for the exact effect, use and audience (R-SV10). Separate from disposition (claim vetting).

verdict.description: When the assessment judges support of a proposition.

charge.description: Net formal charge of the defining structure.

molecularFormula.description: Hill formula as the authority prints it, counter-ions included ('C11H15N2O5.Cl').

molecularWeight.description: Average molecular weight of the defining record (g/mol). A derivation cites the FIELD Assertion that recorded it (authority snapshot + record version), never this cache.

searchText.description: Normalized preferred name, synonyms and label spellings joined for the fulltext index d1_identity_fulltext (Q-D1-26).

substanceClass.description: GSRS substance class of the defining record.

discourseDerivedAt.description: When the PROJECTION Activity derived the discourse cache (R-45 condition 3).

discourseFirstHandCount.description: Discourse projection cache (R-49, CQ-CL-06): occurrences of this Claim whose asserter states it first-hand. Written by a PROJECTION Activity under discourseMethodVersion; authority is the occurrences (OCCURRENCE_OF) and their DERIVED_FROM / OCCURS_IN chains, never this value.

discourseFirstOccurrenceAt.description: Discourse projection cache (R-49, Q-D9-08): earliest valid time among the occurrences (first assertion).

discourseIndependentCount.description: Discourse projection cache (R-49, CQ-CL-06): independent source families among the occurrences, under discourseMethodVersion.

discourseMethodVersion.description: Method version of the discourse projection cache (R-45 condition 3).

discourseRecutCount.description: Discourse projection cache (R-49, CQ-CL-06, Q-D9-08): occurrences in re-published cuts of an earlier work.

discourseRetellingCount.description: Discourse projection cache (R-49, CQ-CL-06, Q-D9-08): occurrences that retell an earlier occurrence.

latestVerdict.description: Projection cache of the latest published evidence report's verdict.

lifecycleState.description: Projection cache maintained by the lifecycle projection; authority is the Assessments and Reports.

refinesClaimUid.description: Projection cache: uid of the broader Claim this one refines (authority: the accepted EQUIVALENCE Assessment with conclusionCode REFINES).

brandName.description: Brand or trade name of a branded material as printed ('Niagen', 'KSM-66', 'LGG'); null for unbranded materials. Mark ownership is a predicate-only Assertion (D8 trademark).

extractionSolvent.description: Extraction solvent as stated ('water', 'ethanol 70% v/v', 'milk' for KSM-66).

extractRatioHigh.description: DER upper bound (equal to extractRatioLow for a single ratio).

extractRatioLow.description: Native herbal substance : preparation ratio (DER), lower bound (5 means 5:1).

formDescriptor.description: Polymorph or form designation as the source states it ('crystalline form', 'micronized').

searchText.description: Names, brand spellings, label strings and synonyms joined for the fulltext index d1_identity_fulltext (Q-D1-26).

interventionTypeVerbatim.description: Registry intervention type as stated (DRUG, DIETARY_SUPPLEMENT, DEVICE, BEHAVIORAL, ...).

materialTextVerbatim.description: What the source named (e.g. 'Nicotinamide riboside chloride, ChromaDex').

quantityBasis.description: D6 enum AmountBasis (owner D6, R-58; e.g. PER_DOSE, PER_DAY, PER_KG_DIET, MEDIUM_CONCENTRATION).

asOfStatementVerbatim.description: Declared as-of statement ('correct as of January 2022'), verbatim; the parsed date bounds the episode's valid time.

compositionDigest.description: sha256:<hex> over the normalized composition lines only (resolved target uid, amount, unit, referent, basis, parent); equal digest = same formulation (CQ-ID-05).

contentDigest.description: sha256:<hex> over the normalized panel (all fields and lines); identity fallback.

firstObservedAt.description: Observation cache (executor-maintained from evidencing snapshots; read-only semantics): first and last retrievedAt.

labelVersionCode.description: Version code printed on the label or registered by DSLD (productVersionCode).

maxDailyServings.description: Maximum suggested daily servings from the directions (Q-D6-09: max declared daily intake = this × line amount).

seals.description: Seals and certification marks as printed ('NSF Certified for Sport', 'Alkemist Assured'); scope checks are CQ-PF-03b assessments.

entityKind.description: LEGAL_ENTITY, CORPORATE_GROUP, DIVISION_OR_UNIT, PUBLIC_BODY (Q-D7-01, Q-D7-14, Q-D7-19 filter on it).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1/-2 code of formation (LEGAL_ENTITY) or of authority (PUBLIC_BODY).

legalFormVerbatim.description: Legal form as printed (Delaware corporation, LLC, Limited, S.A., P.A.).

legalName.description: Current registered legal name (display projection of the latest LEGAL_NAME Assertion); null when not a LEGAL_ENTITY.

organizationKind.description: Coarse kind for filtering (Q-D7-11, Q-D7-13, Q-D7-22); never a role.

status.description: Registry or self-declared status (projection of the latest ORGANIZATION_STATUS Assertion).

outcomeKey.description: Normalized measure + timepoint; equal across sources and versions for the same measure.

timepoint.description: Timepoint or time frame as stated ('20 weeks', 'median 4.7 years').

componentSummary.description: Kits and multipacks: component summary as printed ('2 x 90 capsules'); component edges are predicate-only CONTAINS_PACKAGE.

unitCount.description: Count of dosage units or served items (30 capsules; 1 sandwich); denominator of price per unit and per dose.

credentialsVerbatim.description: Post-nominal credentials as printed (MD, PhD, RD); display and filter only, never a role fact.

description.description: Display headline; facts in it are not queryable until asserted.

influenceDerivedAt.description: When the PROJECTION Activity derived the influence cache (R-45 condition 3).

influenceMethodVersion.description: Method version of the influence cache, e.g. d9-influence/pagerank-v1 (R-45 condition 3).

influenceScore.description: Discourse projection cache (R-49, Q-D9-19): influence score of this person over the retelling graph (PageRank class), graph-wide, under influenceMethodVersion. A per-topic or per-frontier score is not stored here (open-questions FU-11). Authority: the occurrences and retellings it was computed from.

publicActorBasis.description: Why this person is a public actor (privacy gate; Q-D7-18, Q-D7-24 filter on it).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 code when the product is market-specific; null for multi-market products.

marketedName.description: Marketed name as the brand prints it (identity key with the brand).

productKind.description: Filter for every ranking and avoidance question (Q-D6-03, Q-D6-12, Q-D6-22).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 market of this variant (US vs UK fries; '500mg (Canada)').

strengthVerbatim.description: Strength as printed ('300 mg', '12 g scoop'); the typed amount lives on label component lines.

revisionStatus.description: Read-only projection cache over incoming REVISES and kernel HAS_REVISION_STATUS Assertions (method publication-revision-status/v2), typed by the kernel SourceRevisionKind; null = none known (R-44). The single work-level cache; authority stays with those per-asserter Assertions. Filter to exclude retracted work.

revisionStatusMethodVersion.description: Method version of the revisionStatus cache (directive rule 8), e.g. publication-revision-status/v2.

venueName.description: Journal or server name as printed: venue name only, no container node (R-71).

versionLabel.description: Version label (v1…v4 for medRxiv, pub2 for Cochrane).

bodyDigest.description: sha256:<hex> of the registered report bytes (verification-report-ledger.v1 reportArtifact).

citationCompleteness.description: verification.v1 report-wide metrics: claimWeightedCitationCompleteness, citationCorrectness (nullable in v1).

custodyKind.description: Custody kind of bodyUri (e.g. supabase-knowledge-artifacts, content-addressed and immutable; OD-14) (R-SV10).

independentSourceFamilyCount.description: verification.v1 reportWide independentSourceFamilyCount / distinctSourceFamilyCount (independence of the cited evidence). Source family = the evidence's OCCURS_IN work, else its Source's RENDITION_OF work (D9 MediaWork or D3 Publication), else the Source (R-43).

ledgerDigest.description: sha256:<hex> of the verification report ledger and of the sealed audit bundle.

policyVersion.description: PolicyVersion id the publication was admitted under (node in D10 if promoted).

queryDigest.description: ANSWER: digest of the read intent (query shape) that produced it, for replay.

recordedTo.description: Written once when a revision (a new Report naming supersedesUid) or a withdrawal replaces this one.

reportKindRef.description: Versioned report-kind reference of the revision (R-SV10); refines reportKind without new enum values.

reportRevisionRef.description: Immutable reference to the Knowledge Services report revision (ReportRevision) this Report materializes (R-SV10).

reportSchema.description: Report contract of that revision, e.g. research-report.v2 (R-SV10).

skeletonKey.description: D10 skeleton name and version (e.g. d10.compound-profile@1, d10.frontier-brief@1); refines reportKind without new enum values.

structuredBodyDigest.description: sha256:<hex> of the structured report body the rendered body (bodyDigest) was compiled from (R-SV10).

supersedesReportRevisionRef.description: Report revision this one supersedes (R-SV10); the graph-level revision link stays supersedesUid.

unsupportedHighSeverityCount.description: Count of verification.v1 reportWide.unsupportedHighSeverityAssertionIds (a publication gate input).

verdict.description: EVIDENCE_REPORT: the verification.v1 lattice verdict on the Claim it ASSESSES (the exact proposition: that Claim's propositionHash), after the mission tried to disqualify it.

worldCorrectness.description: EVIDENCE_REPORT: verification.v1 world-correctness of the judged Claim (orthogonal to verdict; no aggregate erases either).

overallStatus.description: Projection cache: status of the latest registry version (Q-D3-02, Q-D3-10, Q-D3-18).

phase.description: Projection cache: phase of the latest registry version (Q-D3-10).

primaryCompletionDate.description: Projection cache: expected or actual primary completion of the latest version (Q-D3-02, Q-D3-10).

projectionMethodVersion.description: Method version of the projection cache (directive rule 8).

projectionOfRegistrationVersionUid.description: uid of the RegistrationVersion the cache was projected from.

resultsPosted.description: Projection cache: true when the latest registry version has posted results (Q-D3-02).

studyKind.description: Design (filter: Q-D3-04 ranking, Q-D3-06 preclinical, CQ-ST-07).

armKey.description: Normalized label used to match arms across sources (never identity across sources).

name.description: Arm label as stated (e.g. 'Fisetin Treatment Group').

enrichmentText.description: Enrichment as stated (e.g. 'highest tertile of p16 expression').

comparatorArmKey.description: armKey of the reference arm of a BETWEEN_ARM comparison.

direction.description: Direction of the point estimate (EstimateDirection: neutral, never benefit / harm).

dispersionValue.description: SD or SE value when dispersionKind is STANDARD_DEVIATION or STANDARD_ERROR.

intervalLower.description: Bounds of a CI, IQR or full range (pinned ciLower / ciUpper).

resultText.description: Verbatim result sentence or cell text.

subgroupLabel.description: Subgroup the result is restricted to, as stated ('female', 'site: UM', 'highest p16 tertile'); null = the whole analysis population (replaces pinned HAS_ANALYZED_COHORT for sex-, site- and enrichment-limited results).

unitCode.description: UCUM unit of estimate and interval.

parentKey.description: Parent key for a level-2 target (target:fat-loss -> target:body-composition); null at top level.

synonyms.description: Feeds the fulltext index TargetSearch(label, synonyms, definition) used for entity linking of goal phrases.

vocabVersion.description: vocab-targets.yaml version at creation or last edit.
